candidate.description: Build the off-chain payout engine for "IMD Money Back" ($MONEYBACK): a TypeScript service that reads Robinhood Chain (4663), finds every 15 min which holders are underwater and pays them back in IMD via RoundPayout. TypeScript + tsx + viem + vitest, Linux VPS under pm2. Deliver: package.json, tsconfig, src/, test/, scripts/, env.example, ecosyst...
